highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands image filter, color filter, and paint bounds APIs.
highlights_body: It also restores fast small-sigma raster blurs, reduces repeated SKSurface.Canvas access overhead, and refreshes HarfBuzz shaping.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now produce compile errors
breaking.body: The legacy GRBackendRenderTarget constructors with sampleCount, SKRunBuffer span methods, SKPaintHinting, and SKFilterQuality are now error-obsolete. Use the constructors without sampleCount, the Glyphs or Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive integration removed
breaking.body: The deprecated SkiaSharp.DotNet.Interactive extension is no longer included in the SkiaSharp package. Applications and notebooks that depend on its renderers must provide their own display integration.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and compatibility across Windows, WebAssembly, and Direct3D builds.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() to compute conservative paint bounds for safe use with SKCanvas.QuickReject().

bullets.lead: Image filter composition gains crop and empty nodes
bullets.detail: Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() with tile-mode and input-filter overloads, plus SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty() for explicitly transparent filter output.
Adds SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() to map SKOverdrawCanvas counts through a six-color heat-map palette.
Routes small CPU image blurs back through the faster box-approximation path used by Chromium.
Updates the bundled m150 engine with an upstream fix for concurrent stream access in the macOS CoreText typeface implementation.
Caches SKSurface.Canvas across repeated accesses and recreates the managed wrapper if a caller explicitly disposes it.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Small-sigma raster blur performance, SKSurface.Canvas wrapper caching, and the v4 obsolete API transition

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.summary: Opens the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update and its cross-platform native build adaptations.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.summary: Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to compile errors, removes the deprecated .NET Interactive integration, and updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.summary: Adds paint bounds, image filter crop and empty nodes, and overdraw visualization while improving raster blur and SKSurface.Canvas performance.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 with fixes for AAT and Arabic shaping, COLR v1 rendering, glyph extents, and subsetting.
